free_tier.stated: "Published GitHub Pages sites may be no larger than 1 GB"; source repositories "recommended limit of 1 GB". Bandwidth: "a *soft* bandwidth limit of 100 GB per month".

egress.terms: 100 GB/month soft cap, then throttling or a support email; served from Fastly ('Via: 1.1 varnish, X-Served-By: cache-bom-...'). Free to Cloudflare in front.

tooling: git push to a pages branch, or actions/deploy-pages; any static generator. No special client needed.
chaining: one site per account ('You can only create one user or organization site for each account'), so multiplication is accounts x 1 GB — hundreds of accounts for a TB. Poor.
limits_note: 1 GB published, 100 GB/month bandwidth, 10-minute deploy timeout, 10 builds/hour (not applicable with a custom Actions workflow).
reliability_note: Soft limits are enforced by support action rather than by hard rejection; rate limiting returns 429.

evidence.proved: 'Published GitHub Pages sites may be no larger than 1 GB'; 'soft bandwidth limit of 100 GB per month'
probe: GET pages.github.com -> 200, Via: 1.1 varnish, X-Served-By: cache-bom-vanm7210067-BOM (Fastly)
